key_insight: EMGKT improves radiology report generation by transferring medical knowledge at multiple granularity levels, using teacher-student fine-grained distillation plus expert disease classifiers.
clinical_relevance: The approach could help X-ray report systems produce more accurate, clinically grounded descriptions with less added inference cost.
method: Builds global medical context with a vision-language model.
Uses fine-grained knowledge distillation: teacher embeddings use extra priors, student embeddings learn to retain that knowledge for inference.
Adds a mixture of disease diagnosis expert classifiers initialized from disease embeddings to capture different granularity features.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports extensive experiments on two public datasets across multiple baselines, showing EMGKT is effective and transferable.
watch_item: The method depends on training-time extra priors and added modeling complexity, so real-world integration may require careful validation and calibration.
paper_title: Efficient Multi-Granularity Knowledge Transfer for Radiology Report Generation
